title: The "no writable record" rule lives in three places with different conditions
evidence: Follows S52. ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift:399 applyInTurn refuses on predatesErase or (drawn == nil and problem == nil); RecordStore+Uploads.swift:27 and :75 refuse on predatesErase alone; RecordStore+Readable.swift:14 readable is nil on predatesErase or an empty recordJSON. Three readings of one question (may this record be read or written?) that can drift apart. A candidate for one named state on the store, read by all three. US-25 AC16f, AC21
